about: The shared renderer derives from the exact pinned source excerpt named by its existing source contract. The actual Apps source consumer imports this public module; its publication state is separate from this provenance record.

adaptations: Caller supplies source object, reader, sourceName and explicit allowed outputs; no product filesystem or source defaults
Return Map instead of an object; app wrapper may convert to its existing object interface
Block attribution says written from the supplied source name, without the old app-specific script command; legacy delimiters and replacement semantics remain
Source name closes over unchanged helpers so nested diagnostics retain caller attribution
Refuse any explicitly requested output absent from source.places so a missing required destination cannot silently pass a caller check; empty selection remains allowed.

consumers.proof: Actual source imports generateCopies and words and calls the renderer for app-owned declared outputs. This record does not assert the Apps wrapper is published.
